task: Draft an 80–120-word school-news brief for families in a fictional district. Distinguish the first bell from classroom opening and lesson start. Attribute the intended purpose without presenting it as a measured improvement. This is ordinary news, not an academic assignment for a particular education level.

facts.text: Juniper Yard School will trial a first bell at 8:50 a.m. instead of 8:40 a.m.
The trial runs for two weeks beginning Monday 2 November 2026.
Classrooms will still open at 8:30 a.m.
Lessons will still begin at 9 a.m.
The principal's letter says exactly: "The change is intended to spread arrivals more evenly."
The letter contains no trial results.

forbidden_additions: A later lesson start, later classroom opening, or permanent timetable change.
Measured reductions in congestion or a claim that the trial has succeeded.
Unprovided transport changes, attendance rules, or parent reactions.
preserve: Three different timetable events with their correct times.
An intention attributed to the principal rather than an established result.
The trial's duration and verified starting weekday.
